title.first_pact_description: A self-contained journey through the canopy and bamboo valley. Progress here does not change your campaign.
title.no_continue: No saved journey is available. Start a new game to enter Erya.
title.new_game_body: Start a new campaign with its own choices and Dominion history. Choose a save slot for this journey.

pause.title: Paused

pause.return_title_body: Unsaved progress will be lost. Confirmed Dominion choices are not undone.
pause.focus_lost: The game is paused. Resume when you are ready.
pause.controller_disconnected: Controller disconnected. Reconnect it or use your keyboard and mouse to continue.
pause.defeated_body: Return to the last checkpoint and try another approach.
pause.tali_retry_body: Restart the checkpoint to reach Tali before the danger closes in.

save.title: Save Game
save.saving_notice: Keep the game open while your journey is being saved.
save.save_unavailable: Saving is unavailable during this sequence. Reach a safe checkpoint first.
save.overwrite_body: The selected save will be replaced. Confirmed Dominion history for this journey will remain.
save.load_confirm_body: Unsaved progress will be lost. Loading an earlier save does not erase confirmed Dominion choices in the same journey.
save.history_retained: This journey's Dominion history has been retained. The Living Pact remains unavailable even at an earlier checkpoint.
save.export_description: Download a copy of your checkpoint and this journey's recorded history.
save.import_description: Choose an exported save file. Importing a save from the same journey retains any Dominion history already recorded here.

accessibility.telegraph_intensity_description: Adjust the visibility of attack warnings on the ground and around enemies.
accessibility.offscreen_warning_strength_description: Adjust how strongly incoming attacks outside the camera view are signaled.
accessibility.camera_shake_description: Reduce camera shake during impacts and large attacks.
accessibility.motion_blur_description: Reduce blur during movement and combat.
accessibility.high_contrast_target_ring_description: Make the selected target's ground ring easier to distinguish.
accessibility.auto_target_assist_description: Assist target selection in the direction of your input. You still choose when to attack.

accessibility.lock_on_hold: Hold to maintain lock-on. Release to let go.

accessibility.echo_subtitles_description: Display the brief impressions shared through Echo Sense.

credits.thanks: Thank you for walking with Erya.

loading.tip_direction: You choose the direction and timing of a Dodge. The movement adapts to the space around you.
loading.tip_pounce: A pounce follows a long path. Move sideways out of its landing area rather than relying on a backward roll.
loading.tip_cleanse: Break Ferocity, expose Corruption, then use Root Tether to create a chance to Cleanse.
loading.tip_restoration: Cleansing Black Sap is only a beginning. Water, food, and trust still need to be restored.
loading.tip_companions: Companions open opportunities. Their special abilities need your signal.
loading.tip_consent: A coalition is not yet a Living Pact. Each faction must choose to renew its commitment.
loading.tip_history: A confirmed Dominion choice remains in that journey, even if you load an earlier save.

hud.vitality_description: Your ability to keep going. If Vitality is depleted, return to the last checkpoint.
hud.mana_description: Walk or run to earn 4 mana per metre. Skills consume mana; blocked movement and evasions do not restore it.
hud.instinct_description: Build Instinct through combat and Perfect Dodges.
hud.ferocity_description: An animal's ability to keep fighting. Break Ferocity to expose its Corruption.
hud.corruption_description: Black Sap's hold on this creature. Expose the core and Cleanse it.
hud.wave_warning: Ground Wave: Use the Vault Opening
hud.eruption_warning: Corruption Eruption: Leave the Marked Area
hud.ally_possessed_help: Avoid their attacks and break Orun's hold without harming your ally.

commands.title: Companion Commands
commands.ask_unlocked: The Call is gone. The bond is not.
commands.ask_description: Ask willing companions for help. Agreed support and traversal abilities remain available without the Warden's Call.

follow.label: Follow
follow.description: Stay close and move with me.

stay.label: Stay
stay.description: Wait here until I call you back.

search.label: Search
search.description: Look for a trail or nearby opportunity.

recall.label: Recall
recall.description: Leave the current task and regroup with me.

commands.status_unwilling_help: Review this faction's needs in the Journal.

companions.title: Companions
companions.koro_provisional: Koro will help you through this stretch of forest. His help is not yet a lasting Bond with the Canopy.
companions.solkar_exiled: Solkar is in exile and is not available as a companion. A voluntary council can represent the Crown faction.

mark_path.label: Mark Path
mark_path.description: Reveal a route through the terrain.

mark_weakness.label: Mark Weakness
mark_weakness.description: Draw attention to an exposed enemy weakness.

storm_talon.label: Storm Talon
storm_talon.description: A Wind dive grants you +12% movement speed for 4 seconds on contact. Deals only 4 damage, or 6 to a marked target. 10-second cooldown.

offscreen_warning.label: Danger Warning
offscreen_warning.description: Warn of attacks approaching outside your view. Basic danger warnings remain available even without Vara.

mark_landing.label: Mark Landing
mark_landing.description: Clarify where a pouncing enemy will land.

rope.label: Set Rope
rope.description: Prepare a rope at a suitable crossing.

lever.label: Pull Lever
lever.description: Reach and operate a nearby mechanism.

retrieve_item.label: Retrieve Item
retrieve_item.description: Reach an item beyond Aren's grasp.

mending_seed.label: Mending Seed
mending_seed.description: A Wood seed restores 8% of your maximum Vitality on contact with a nearby enemy. No vitality damage. 14-second cooldown.

drop_object.label: Drop Object
drop_object.description: Release a suspended object at the right moment.

rescue_pull.label: Rescue Pull
rescue_pull.description: At a prepared opening, pull Aren clear of a large danger area. This support is not available against every attack.

pounce.label: Pounce
pounce.description: Leap onto the selected threat and create an opening.

armor_break.label: Armor Break
armor_break.description: Break through an enemy's protection when an opening appears.

charge_block.label: Charge Block
charge_block.description: Intercept a charge during a clear support opening.

break_obstacles.label: Break Obstacles
break_obstacles.description: Clear obstacles marked for Asha's strength.

track.label: Track
track.description: Follow a scent trail through the region.

find_secrets.label: Find Hidden Trails
find_secrets.description: Investigate nearby traces that may lead to a hidden route.

flank.label: Undertow Flank
flank.description: A Water lunge slows enemy movement by 35% for 4 seconds; bosses resist to 15% for 3 seconds. No vitality damage. 10-second cooldown.

hold.label: Hold
hold.description: Restrain a vulnerable target long enough to create an opening.

flank_warning.label: Flank Warning
flank_warning.description: Warn when a threat moves around your side.

hidden_route.label: Reveal Hidden Route
hidden_route.description: Find a concealed path through the region.

ambush.label: Static Ambush
ambush.description: A Lightning pounce cuts your remaining skill cooldowns by 20%, at most 1.5 seconds per skill. No vitality damage. 12-second cooldown.

ambush_counter.label: Ambush Counter
ambush_counter.description: Coordinate an ambush after a Perfect Dodge when Nyra is ready.

calm_wildlife.label: Calm Wildlife
calm_wildlife.description: Ease nearby wildlife's fear and help open a peaceful passage.

roar.label: Roar
roar.description: Disrupt the enemy's pressure with a commanding roar.

ember_rally.label: Ember Rally
ember_rally.description: A Fire roar gives you +12% strike damage for 5 seconds. Does not stack or restore Instinct. No vitality damage. 12-second cooldown.

interrupt_charge.label: Interrupt Charged Attack
interrupt_charge.description: Interrupt a charging area attack during a rare support opening.

evasion.title: Wild Flow Evasion
evasion.overview: Combine Dodge with a movement direction. Choose when and where to move; the animation adapts to the visible attack and terrain.
evasion.charges: Dodge uses charges, not Instinct. When charges are empty, reposition and use clear space until they recover.
evasion.ground_wave_rule: Low Slide does not avoid a ground wave. Use the marked Staff Vault opening or move beyond the hazard.
evasion.hazard_rule: A Dodge does not make every hazard harmless. Clear the attack's height, path, and area.

quick_step_left.label: Quick Step Left
quick_step_left.description: Make a short Dodge left to avoid a small projectile or single strike.

quick_step_right.label: Quick Step Right
quick_step_right.description: Make a short Dodge right to avoid a small projectile or single strike.

forward_shoulder_roll.label: Forward Shoulder Roll
forward_shoulder_roll.description: Roll forward through a clear opening to leave a ground-smash area or change depth.

back_handspring.label: Back Handspring
back_handspring.description: Create distance from a close bite, claw combination, or roar cone while facing the threat.

left_cartwheel.label: Left Cartwheel
left_cartwheel.description: Dodge left across the path of a straight charge, pounce, or line attack.

right_cartwheel.label: Right Cartwheel
right_cartwheel.description: Dodge right across the path of a straight charge, pounce, or line attack.

forward_left_dive_roll.label: Forward-Left Dive Roll
forward_left_dive_roll.description: Dive diagonally forward and left to clear a large attack area. Leave room for a longer recovery.

forward_right_dive_roll.label: Forward-Right Dive Roll
forward_right_dive_roll.description: Dive diagonally forward and right to clear a large attack area. Leave room for a longer recovery.

back_left_pivot_roll.label: Back-Left Pivot Roll
back_left_pivot_roll.description: Roll diagonally back and left to reposition through a clear gap.

back_right_pivot_roll.label: Back-Right Pivot Roll
back_right_pivot_roll.description: Roll diagonally back and right to reposition through a clear gap.

low_slide.label: Low Slide
low_slide.description: Slide under a clearly signaled body-height sweep or flying obstacle. Do not slide into a ground wave.

staff_vault.label: Staff Vault
staff_vault.description: Use a marked opening to vault a low sweep, ground wave, or suitable obstacle.

perfect_dodge_left.label: Perfect Dodge Left
perfect_dodge_left.description: Dodge left just before an incoming strike connects. A successful close escape builds Instinct and opens a counter opportunity.

perfect_dodge_right.label: Perfect Dodge Right
perfect_dodge_right.description: Dodge right just before an incoming strike connects. A successful close escape builds Instinct and opens a counter opportunity.

dodge_recovery.label: Dodge Recovery
dodge_recovery.description: Regain your stance after a Dodge. Watch for the opening to move or counter.

hard_landing.label: Hard Landing
hard_landing.description: A heavy landing leaves Aren recovering his footing. Give yourself space before the next threat.

stumble_recovery.label: Stumble Recovery
stumble_recovery.description: Recover your balance after a stumble and reassess the attack path.

counters.title: Dodge Counters
counters.overview: Act during the counter opening after a successful Dodge. Choose a quick response or coordinate with a ready companion.

cartwheel_staff_sweep.label: Cartwheel to Staff Sweep
cartwheel_staff_sweep.description: Follow a cartwheel opening with a sweeping staff counter.

back_handspring_root_tether.label: Back Handspring to Root Tether
back_handspring_root_tether.description: Tether the exposed target after creating space with a Back Handspring.

slide_low_sweep.label: Low Slide to Low Sweep
slide_low_sweep.description: Follow a slide opening with a low staff sweep.

dive_roll_thrust.label: Dive Roll to Thrust
dive_roll_thrust.description: Recover from a Dive Roll into a focused staff thrust.

staff_vault_downward_strike.label: Staff Vault to Downward Strike
staff_vault_downward_strike.description: Follow a vault opening with a downward staff strike.

tutorial.title: Tutorials
tutorial.movement_body: Move left and right across the view, or toward and away from the camera to change depth. Erya has room beyond a single lane.
tutorial.dodge_body: Move in a direction and use Dodge. Read the enemy's body, the ground warning, and the sound before committing.
tutorial.perfect_dodge_body: Escape just before a threatening attack connects to earn a Perfect Dodge. Build Instinct and look for an exposed weakness.
tutorial.charge_body: A charge follows a line. Dodge across that line into clear space rather than retreating along it.
tutorial.pounce_body: Watch the landing mark. Dodge sideways after the pounce commits. Backing away along its path may not be enough.
tutorial.claw_body: A claw combination can have more than one strike. Create space and wait for the recovery before countering.
tutorial.roar_body: Read the roar's cone on the ground. Move out of its spread before it reaches you.
tutorial.wave_body: A ground wave travels low. Use the visible Staff Vault opening. Low Slide will not protect you.
tutorial.light_attack_body: Use light staff attacks to disrupt smaller enemies and build Instinct. Your goal is to stop the threat, not kill it.
tutorial.heavy_attack_body: Heavy attacks reduce Ferocity and break protection. Charging a heavy attack leaves you less mobile, so choose a clear opening.
tutorial.root_tether_body: Use Root Tether to restrain a vulnerable target or hold an exposed Corruption core. Its hold is limited; be ready to act.
tutorial.cleanse_body: Break Ferocity to expose Corruption. Use Root Tether, coordinate support when available, then approach and Cleanse the core.
tutorial.cleanse_missed: The opening has closed. Some Ferocity has returned. Read the next attack and create another chance.
tutorial.echo_sense_body: Echo Sense shares impressions, memories, and brief phrases. Animals do not speak as humans do.
tutorial.companion_body: Open Companion Commands, choose an action, and indicate a suitable target. Special abilities need your decision.
tutorial.koro_body: Koro has agreed to help for now. Use his rope and environmental support where prompted. A lasting Canopy Bond still has to be earned.
tutorial.asha_body: Asha can Pounce, use Charge Block, and Break Obstacles. Choose her support opening; she cannot intercept every threat.
tutorial.traversal_body: Use marked vaults, ledges, slides, and swings to cross obstacles. There is no free jump.
tutorial.restoration_body: Cleansing removes Black Sap's hold. Restore water, food, and safe passage to help the region recover.
tutorial.bond_body: Protect communities, restore their homes, and honor their choices. Combat cooperation alone cannot replace a faction's covenant obligations.
tutorial.ask_body: After the fall of the Grove, Ask replaces the Warden's Call. Willing companions can still respond to your signals and help with agreed abilities.
tutorial.refuge_body: Save, train, and organize your companions at the refuge. These services remain available after the Grove falls.
tutorial.finale_support_body: Companion support can clarify or shorten a route through the Hollow. If a companion is absent, read the terrain and attack cues for Aren's own way through.

interactions.skip_cinematic_description: Continue with the same story outcome.

journal.title: Journal
journal.no_tracked_objective: No objective is being tracked. Select one in the Journal.
journal.no_memories: Echo memories you discover will appear here.
journal.no_side_quests: No side quests have been discovered yet.
journal.main_rescue_note: Rescuing Tali from the camp is part of the main journey. The Last Cub concerns the nursery and evacuation route afterward.
journal.separate_status_note: Restoring a region and settling its leadership are separate responsibilities.
journal.chapter_seven_note: The Wild March brings a coalition together. It does not automatically establish the Living Pact.

restoration.title: Restoration
restoration.unvisited_description: Explore this region to learn what it needs.
restoration.corrupted_description: Black Sap and unresolved damage threaten this region.
restoration.partial_description: Recovery has begun, but the region's restoration work is not complete.
restoration.restored_description: The region's restoration work is complete. Its political commitments are recorded separately.
restoration.new_life: Wildlife is returning. Listen for the changes around you.

relationships.bond_description: Strength earned through protection, restoration, and freely chosen cooperation.
relationships.dominion_description: Compel obedience and gain stronger support sooner, at the cost of trust and greater vulnerability to Orun's control.
relationships.covenant_description: The faction has reached Bond tier 3 through its required commitments.
relationships.consent_note: A representative must choose to participate. Possession of a fragment is not consent.

dominion_warning.title: This Choice Permanently Closes the Living Pact
dominion_warning.body: Using Dominion on any leader permanently makes the Living Pact ending unavailable for this journey. Raising Bond later, loading an earlier save, restarting a checkpoint, or importing an earlier save from the same journey will not undo that history.
dominion_warning.consequence: Dominion grants powerful support sooner, but imposed obedience weakens trust and leaves companions more vulnerable to Orun's control.
dominion_warning.other_endings: The Dominion and Severance endings remain available.
dominion_warning.new_journey: A New Game begins a separate journey with a new history.
dominion_warning.recorded: Dominion confirmed. The Living Pact is now unavailable for this journey.

fragments.after_asha: Three fragments are gathered: Sky, Canopy, and Fang.
fragments.all_gathered: All six Heartroot fragments are gathered.
fragments.representation_note: Gathering a fragment does not establish a covenant or guarantee its faction's voluntary support.
fragments.crown_exile_note: The Crown fragment remains part of the journey after Solkar's exile. A willing council can represent the Crown faction.

living_pact.title: The Living Pact
living_pact.available_description: Every Living Pact requirement is met. You may choose the Living Pact at the crown. Dominion and Severance remain choices too.
living_pact.not_ready_description: Review the unmet commitments below. Gathering fragments or joining the Wild March does not satisfy these requirements by itself.
living_pact.historically_locked_description: A leader was dominated in this journey. That history cannot be erased by restoring Bond or loading an earlier save from the same journey.

choices.title: Choose Your Response
choices.consider: Consider the immediate result and the commitment that follows.

moonpine_ruun.label: Restore Ruun
moonpine_ruun.description: Let Ruun lead a disciplined pack rooted in its traditions.

moonpine_luma.label: Support Luma
moonpine_luma.description: Support a more adaptable pack with a stronger scouting role.

moonpine_dominion.label: Compel Both Packs
moonpine_dominion.description: Force both leaders to submit. Gain immediate strength, increase vulnerability to Orun, and permanently close the Living Pact for this journey.

sunmane_bond.label: Ask Solkar to Renounce Fear
sunmane_bond.description: Solkar remains a leader, but must abandon rule through fear and coercive tribute.

sunmane_exile.label: Exile Solkar
sunmane_exile.description: Solkar leaves. The herds form a council that can voluntarily represent Crown. Solkar will not be available as a companion.

sunmane_dominion.label: Dominate Solkar
sunmane_dominion.description: Force Solkar to obey. Gain immediate power and permanently close the Living Pact for this journey.

marek_help.label: Cleanse Marek

marek_leave.label: Leave Marek
marek_leave.description: Leave him behind and seek another way to uncover the river's secret.

river_break_dam.label: Break the Dam
river_break_dam.description: Release the water quickly, changing the floodplain and its routes.

river_repair.label: Repair the Waterway
river_repair.description: Take the slower approach and preserve a different passage through the region.

final_dominion.label: Take the Root Crown

final_severance.label: Break the Root Crown

final_living_pact.label: Share the Root Crown
final_living_pact.description: Divide its power among six willing factions and establish the Circle of the Wild.

choices.final_confirm_body: This choice determines the ending and epilogue for this journey.

dominion.title: Dominion: The Wild King
dominion.summary: Aren takes the Root Crown. Conflict ends beneath a single command. The animals bow, and the forest grows silent.
dominion.grove: The Grove stands in ordered silence. Even the birds wait for permission to fly.

severance.title: Severance: The Free Wild
severance.summary: Aren breaks the Root Crown. Six fragments return to their regions. Erya remains imperfect, but no one holds the power to command every living creature.
severance.grove: Companions remain by choice. The Grove belongs to no throne.

living_pact.title: The Living Pact
living_pact.summary: Aren shares the Root Crown among six willing factions. Orun relinquishes power, Yara returns to life, and the Circle of the Wild forms without a throne.
living_pact.grove: Six paths lead out from the Grove. Every people may choose to join the pact or leave it.
living_pact.yara_last_line: So, what will they call you now?
living_pact.aren_last_line: They do not need to call me anything.

endings.return_before_finale_notice: Resume the checkpoint before the finale, not a world after the ending. This journey's recorded Dominion history is retained.
